{{Otheruses|River}}
'''Reyno River''' was a fast-flowing [[River|waterway]] located on the arboreal [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Brosi]]. The river cut through [[Blan Forests|Blan Forest]] along the [[Reyno Valley]] floor, before branching off into two main tributaries: a [[West Reyno River|western branch]] that emptied into the [[Bay of Sypon]], and a northern branch that emptied into [[Nomers Ocean]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
